proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated/defaulted/overridden from env and synchronized across ranks in init/comm state. Add enqueue because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream capture/mixing behavior and related enqueue/channel/transport stream-acquire/release semantics. Add device-topology because P2P channel budgeting is recomputed from NIC path bandwidth and maxP2pPeers constraints in graph path/channel computation.
